nodeMajor.description: Node major version for the typescript-node base image tag. Defaults to the running Node major.

firebase.description: Include Firebase CLI + Google Cloud CLI devcontainer features, the toba.vsfire VS Code extension, and labeled portsAttributes for the Firebase emulator suite (4000 UI, 9099 Auth, 8080 Firestore, 9150 ws, 9199 Storage, 5001 Functions). No explicit forwardPorts — VS Code auto-forwards each binding to a free host port so multiple devcontainers can run in parallel without collision. Opt-in only - never enabled by default.

web.description: The `web` LAYER: this workspace has something to serve. Adds the :80 worktree-domains forward, the shared browser's noVNC portsAttributes band, the auto-forward settings those depend on, the --sysctl/--add-host runArgs, the containerEnv devcontainer id, and the Playwright + shared-port volume mounts. Framework-agnostic — the shared browser is pure CDP and the proxy forwards any localhost port. Defaults to true; pass --web=false for a workspace with nothing to serve (a library-only or docs repo).

angular.description: The `angular` LAYER: adds the Angular VS Code extensions (nrwl.angular-console, Angular.ng-template) and labels port 4200 as the Angular dev server. Opt-in — a non-Angular workspace should not carry Angular editor tooling.

voice.description: Bridge the host's PulseAudio-protocol socket (WSLg, or native PulseAudio/PipeWire) into the container so the bespunky-voice plugin can reach the host speaker + mic. Adds .devcontainer/host-probe.sh (run as initializeCommand on every open: it points the gitignored .devcontainer/.host/pulse at this machine's socket folder, or leaves an empty dir when the host has no audio, so the container always starts), the bind mount of that path to /run/bespunky/host/pulse, and remoteEnv PULSE_SERVER + BESPUNKY_HOST_WSL_DISTRO. The companion post-create.sh self-adapts on a socket actually arriving: it installs the espeak-ng TTS floor + pulseaudio-utils and pre-installs the voice plugin only then. Opt-in only - never enabled by default.
